rows: Equipment: Generator loss-of-field protection, 40G, RAGPC, ABB
Procedure: Annual test using secondary-circuit injection, Y1

sections_en.text: This document sets out the test steps that must be carried out annually. The first draft was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud at the New Assiut Power Station "El-Walidia", 2*300 MW, Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company; the test was carried out on the second unit generator on 18 October 2002 by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Eng. Mahmoud Faisal Mohamed.

items: Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, and the test crew must carry the industrial safety category card
Fence off the work area and place the warning signs.
The unit is out of service
Follow the industrial safety and occupational health instructions

sections_en.text: AC V-A current measuring instrument, type YOGOGAWA
AC V-A voltage measuring instrument, type YOGOGAWA

items: PHU-100 current injection set
PHU-100 voltage injection set
AC V-A current measuring instrument, type YOGOGAWA
AC V-A voltage measuring instrument, type YOGOGAWA
KDK DPF-30N phase-shift meter
Millisecond Counter (Timer) type MCS - 5N
Test comb, type RTXH18,
Test leads

sections_en.text: Work Steps to be Carried Out
Place Test plug type RTXH 18 in Test Socket type RTXP18 at the relay 40G

items: Place Test plug type RTXH 18 in Test Socket type RTXP18 at the relay 40G
Short A1A and 2A in test plug RTXP 18
Inject voltage of 100 V at points (9A, 10A) in test plug RTXH 18
Inject current gradually at points (3A, 4A) in test plug RTXH18 until the alarm signal appears (RXPE 40) Alarm under excitation
Record the current reading.
Raise the current until the tripping signal appears: tripping loss-of-field (RXIG2)
Record the current reading.
Reduce the current until the tripping signal disappears and the alarm signal appears
Reduce the voltage gradually until the tripping loss of field (RXEG 2) signal appears
Record the voltage reading.
Connect the Start terminals of the timer to points T1, T2 in the voltage injection set
Connect the Stop terminals of the timer to point 2A in Test plug RTXH 18 and point 28 on auxiliary relay No. 337.
Raise the voltage to 100 V
Raise the current until the tripping signal appears
Disconnect the voltage and current injection sets
Reset the timer
Connect the voltage and current injection sets at the same time
Record the time reading
Remove Test plug type RTXH18 from Test Socket type RTXP 18 at the relay (40G)

Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedures Information System
Maintenance Procedures Information System

Document No.: LOE-001-r0a | Equipment: Generator loss-of-field protection, 40G, RAGPC, ABB
Issued to: El-Walidia Power Station
Status: APPROVED
Approval date: 5 January 2003 | Procedure: Annual test using secondary-circuit injection, Y1
Next review date: January 2008
Introduction
This document sets out the test steps that must be carried out annually. The first draft was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud at the New Assiut Power Station "El-Walidia", 2*300 MW, Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company; the test was carried out on the second unit generator on 18 October 2002 by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Eng. Mahmoud Faisal Mohamed.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, and the test crew must carry the industrial safety category card
Fence off the work area and place the warning signs.
The unit is out of service
Follow the industrial safety and occupational health instructions

Record the current reading.
Raise the current until the tripping signal appears: tripping loss-of-field (RXIG2)
Record the current reading.
Reduce the current until the tripping signal disappears and the alarm signal appears
Reduce the voltage gradually until the tripping loss of field (RXEG 2) signal appears
Record the voltage reading.
Connect the Start terminals of the timer to points T1, T2 in the voltage injection set
Connect the Stop terminals of the timer to point 2A in Test plug RTXH 18 and point 28 on auxiliary relay No. 337.
Raise the voltage to 100 V
Raise the current until the tripping signal appears
Disconnect the voltage and current injection sets
Reset the timer
Connect the voltage and current injection sets at the same time
Record the time reading
Remove Test plug type RTXH18 from Test Socket type RTXP 18 at the relay (40G)
